query: Which method can be used for oxidation resistance, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Alloying with chromium can be used for oxidation resistance
generation.mechanism: Diffusion of chromium to the surface and reaction with oxygen
generation.baseline: Oxidation rate of the base metal alloy
generation.uncertainty: Effectiveness of chromium alloying may vary depending on the specific metal alloy and environmental conditions

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the oxidation rates of metal alloys with and without chromium addition at high temperatures
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the oxidation rate of the chromium-alloyed metal is not significantly lower than that of the base metal alloy, the hypothesis is falsified
